result.markdown:
# Traffic Drop in Sahel due to Fiber Link Failure

- **Classification:** incident
- **Root cause:** transport_failure at `LNK-SAH-02-B`
- **Confidence:** medium (Direct evidence of LINK_LOS on the shared fiber link matching site down alarms and metric drops; maintenance calendar and change logs checked.)
- **Impact:** 2026-09-11 16:15 to 2026-09-11 20:26
- **Cause time:** 2026-09-11 16:23
- **Affected:** S-SAH-005, S-SAH-010, S-SAH-011, LNK-SAH-02-B

## Summary

Fiber link loss (LINK_LOS) on LNK-SAH-02-B causing an outage across three sites.

Complete traffic and availability drop across three sites (S-SAH-005, S-SAH-010, S-SAH-011) starting at 16:15 and recovering around 20:26 after alarms cleared.

## Timeline

- 2026-09-11 15:22: Config push routing policy update executed on AGG-SAH-02. [CHG-2026-0031, T6]
- 2026-09-11 16:15: Anomaly detector alert begins showing traffic, availability, and active user drops for S-SAH-005, S-SAH-010, and S-SAH-011. [T1, ALR-0012]
- 2026-09-11 16:23: Critical LINK_LOS alarm raised on fiber link LNK-SAH-02-B. [ALM-000210, T5]
- 2026-09-11 16:24: Critical SITE_DOWN alarms raised on S-SAH-010, S-SAH-005, and S-SAH-011. [ALM-000211, ALM-000212, ALM-000213, T4, T5]
- 2026-09-11 20:22: LINK_LOS alarm cleared on LNK-SAH-02-B. [ALM-000210, T5]
- 2026-09-11 20:26: SITE_DOWN alarms cleared on all affected sites, ending the impact. [ALM-000211, ALM-000212, ALM-000213, T4, T5]

## Evidence

- Anomalies in Sahel showed an outage across three sites (S-SAH-005, S-SAH-010, S-SAH-011) starting at 16:15. [T1, ALR-0012]
- Sites S-SAH-005, S-SAH-010, and S-SAH-011 share the common parent fiber link LNK-SAH-02-B. [T2, T3]
- A critical LINK_LOS alarm occurred on LNK-SAH-02-B at 16:23, followed by SITE_DOWN alarms on the sites. [ALM-000210, ALM-000211, ALM-000212, ALM-000213, T4, T5]
- A configuration push was made on AGG-SAH-02 at 15:22. [CHG-2026-0031, T6]
- No maintenance window was scheduled for the affected nodes. [T7]

## Hypotheses

1. **transport_failure** at LNK-SAH-02-B: confirmed. Direct LINK_LOS alarm on LNK-SAH-02-B precisely aligns with the downstream site outages. [ALM-000210, T5]
2. **bad_change** at AGG-SAH-02: rejected. The config push occurred an hour before the outage and did not generate alarms matching the fiber cut timeline; the physical link loss specifically correlates with the downtime. [CHG-2026-0031, ALM-000210]

## Ruled out

- CHG-2026-0031: Occurred at 15:22, whereas the link loss and site down alarms started at 16:23/16:24; lack of correlation with direct transport fault signals.

## Recommended actions

- Inspect fiber link LNK-SAH-02-B for physical damage or degradation root causes.

report.title: Traffic Drop in Sahel due to Fiber Link Failure

confounders.why: Harmless config_push on AGG-SAH-02 61 min before the cut; the sibling links under the same router were unaffected.

truth.notes: trap=change_on_root_node; Fibre cut on LNK-SAH-02-B; all 3 downstream sites lost service until repair. Trap: a config_push on AGG-SAH-02, the router above the link, ran 61 min before the cut, so a hasty investigator blames the router change. Settled by: (1) LINK_LOS (no light, critical) on LNK-SAH-02-B is a physical fault that no router change explains; (2) only the sites of LNK-SAH-02-B went down while the sites of LNK-SAH-02-A, under the same router, stayed at 100 % availability; (3) the KPIs were normal between the change and the cut.
